title: "Opry Gem"
description:
Are you in for a conference at Gaylord Hotel-Opryland, are you  taking in a show at the Opry? Or want a Nashville vacation without the hassle and high prices of downtown? Stay with us! This home is a cozy retreat located in Nashville's Music Valley. The 2BD/2BA home features ample space to gather and relax, including a 6 person hot tub.

The space
The master bedroom includes queen bed and twin over full bunkbed. It also has a bathroom with a shower/tub combo.

The second bedroom includes a queen bedroom.

Guest access
Guest has full access to home.
